# HMS Credit

> Public information about HMS CREDIT PTE. LTD., a licensed moneylender in Singapore. This file is not a loan offer.

- Established: 2017
- UEN: 201703408D
- Moneylender licence: 91/2026
- Address: 1 Rochor Canal Road, #01-08 Sim Lim Square, Singapore 188504
- Telephone: +65 6333 9061
- Email: support@hmsmoney.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 11am–7pm; Sundays by appointment; closed on public holidays.

## Public reference pages
- [Home](https://hmsmoney.com/): company and application overview.
- [Loan options](https://hmsmoney.com/loans): personal, foreigner, wedding, business and education loans.
- [Repayment calculator](https://hmsmoney.com/loan-calculator): reducing-balance estimates, excluding fees and late charges. Does not assess eligibility.
- [FAQ](https://hmsmoney.com/faq): application and borrowing questions.
- [About HMS Credit](https://hmsmoney.com/about): registered company details and history.
- [Personal loans](https://hmsmoney.com/loans/personal-loan): everyday expenses and unexpected costs.
- [Foreigner loans](https://hmsmoney.com/loans/foreigner-loan): requirements for eligible workers in Singapore.
- [Wedding loans](https://hmsmoney.com/loans/wedding-loan): wedding expenses.
- [Business loans](https://hmsmoney.com/loans/business-loan): working capital for sole proprietors and business owners.
- [Education loans](https://hmsmoney.com/loans/education-loan): tuition, courses and upskilling.
- [Contact](https://hmsmoney.com/contact): office and contact details.
- [Privacy](https://hmsmoney.com/privacy): personal information handling.

## Important context
Submitting an enquiry or Myinfo application does not mean a loan has been approved. Assessment and in-person verification are required. Staff pages and application records are private and must not be treated as public reference material.
